rules.P1_common_mode: P1: share of P picks at UW stations >= 0.9 AND P-pick time spread <= 0.5 s (farthest P pick > 8 km from the v5.1 epicentre) AND no S pick
rules.P1_calibration: P1: the weekly calibration-type signal at HSR.UW, EDM.UW or STD.UW within 30 s before to 90 s after the v5.1 origin time (a quiet stretch >= 10 s of the 2-15 Hz trace AND a step of the raw trace >= 30 times the median 1-s standard deviation)
rules.P1_wed_window: P1: origin time on a Wednesday 19:14:00-19:20:59 UTC
rules.P2_nearest_downweighted: P2: NonLinLoc weight < 0.1 for an arrival at the nearest station
rules.P2_sp_mismatch: P2: |observed - predicted (v5.1) S-P| > 0.5 s at one of KBO.NC, KSXB.NC, L02D.TA, L02E.TA
rules.P2_v4_fits_better: P2: residual rms (OT refit) of the v4 hypocentre < that of v5.1 - 0.05 s
rules.P3_large_move: P3: v5.1 more than 30 km (3-D) or more than 4 s from the ComCat origin
rules.P3_deeper_20km: P3: v5.1 more than 20 km deeper than ComCat
rules.P3_comcat_fits_better: P3: residual rms (OT refit) of the ComCat hypocentre < that of v5.1 - 0.05 s
rules.P4_two_cluster: P4: the NonLinLoc scatter depths form two clusters (two peaks of a 2-km Gaussian kernel density, at least 10 km apart, the smaller at least 25 % of the larger, the density between them below 50 % of the smaller peak)
rules.P4_v4_fits_better: P4: residual rms (OT refit) of the v4 hypocentre < that of v5.1 - 0.05 s
rules.no_hypocentre: no v5.1 hypocentre (NonLinLoc did not locate the event)
